name: C'est Lavie!
source:
C'est Lavie is a fifteen minute RPG cutscene starring Lavie and Ryan, two of the main characters from Love and War. Apparently, Lavie has decided to try and change the nature of her relationship with Ryan. Little does she know her imagination may be her own worst enemy...

[From [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=klX9_DhPHEI]YouTube[/url]]
translation:
《C'est Lavie!》是一段长约15分钟的RPG剧情片段，主角是《Love and War》中的两位主要角色拉维与瑞恩。看来，拉维决定试着改变自己与瑞恩的关系。可她并不知道，自己的想象力或许才是最大的敌人…

[摘自[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=klX9_DhPHEI]YouTube[/url]]
